exposure: Spontaneous vaginal delivery (SVD) vs. operative vaginal delivery (OVD) vs. cesarean delivery (CD)
12 subgroups based on parity, previous cesarean delivery, and mode of delivery (P-C-MoD classification)
Previous cesarean delivery vs. no previous cesarean delivery
finding: The P-C-MoD classification, which considers parity, previous cesarean delivery, and mode of delivery, effectively identifies women at risk for PPH.
mod_finding: The prevalence of PPH was highest for primiparous women undergoing operative vaginal delivery (27%) compared with multiparous women with spontaneous vaginal delivery (3%).
